mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO reviewNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , CREATOR_NO createNo , REVIEW_NAME reviewName , REVIEW_CONTENT reviewContent , REVIEW_DATE reviewDate , REVIEW_STATUS reviewStatus FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REVIEW_NO DESC
